newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Arafat leaves Tunis for talks in Italy, France.
newsitem.headline: Arafat leaves Tunis for talks in Italy, France.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat left Tunis on Friday for Italy and France for talks on the Middle East peace process following this week's summit in Washington.
PLO officials said Arafat would stop in Naples and meet Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi and Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini.

The Palestinian leader had earlier visited Morocco to brief King Hassan on the summit in Washington which he attended with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Jordan's King Hussein and President Bill Clinton.
Arafat is due to meet French President Jacques Chirac later on Friday.
